name: design-kit
description: A design library for AI coding agents: a /design router that picks the right skill or recipe, plus vetted skills for typography, color, motion, UX writing, usability, landing copy, native iOS and more.

start_mode.title: How should /design start?
start_mode.description: typed: /design runs only when you type it. automatic: the assistant also starts /design when you ask for design work in your own words. Type /design-setup for a plain-English walk through both choices.

ask_before_edits.title: Ask before a design skill edits files?
ask_before_edits.description: On: /design names its pick and waits for your yes before any skill that changes files. Off: it names the pick and starts it.
